notes: A separate ordinary ownership-acquisition cancellation case observes the owner's one release request, cancels the request, and observes one matching confirmation while the requester is otherwise idle in HLA_IMMEDIATE mode. The HLA_EVOKED counterpart uses ordinary callback servicing. The post-cancel immediate wait calls no requester RTI service; the callback recorder is thread-safe. Both paths verify that ownership stays with the original owner. The adapter supplies the provider, model FOM, endpoint, and callback model. Direct pinned mappings are page-161-l137-40 to §7.8, page-170-l13-1 to §7.15, and page-171-l52-13 to §7.16. Idle push timing is a bounded public-API observation without a separate pinned Requirements Lab mapping. This is not process-transport interoperability or conformance evidence.
